STEP 1 - Scene: A plated meal of roasted potatoes, sautéed/roasted vegetables (red and yellow bell pepper, zucchini, red onion) over a grain (bulgur or couscous-like), and a creamy mixed salad or spread (looks like a potato or grain salad with dressing) at the top, with a lemon zest garnish.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 530 cm². Food covers most of the plate's right and center; the top-right salad extends toward the plate edge.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Roasted potatoes (red/yellow skin, herbed)
- Grain (bulgur/couscous-like) with vegetables
- Roasted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, red onion)
- Creamy salad/spread (dressed grain or potato salad, pale with flecks)
- Lemon zest garnish (minor)

STEP 4 - Area:
- Roasted potatoes: 30% (~159 cm²)
- Grain: 12% (~64 cm²)
- Roasted vegetables: 8% (~42 cm²)
- Creamy salad: 15% (~80 cm²)
- Garnish: 1% (~5 cm²)
Total ≈ 66% covered.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Potatoes: 159 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 398 ml
- Grain: 64 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Vegetables: 42 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 63 ml
- Creamy salad: 80 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 160 ml
- Garnish: 5 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 3 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Potatoes: 398 × 0.9 ≈ 358 g
- Grain: 96 × 0.8 ≈ 77 g
- Vegetables: 63 × 0.6 ≈ 38 g
- Creamy salad: 160 × 0.9 ≈ 144 g
- Garnish: 3 × 0.5 ≈ 2 g
Total ≈ 619 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Potatoes: 358 g × 90 kcal/100 g ≈ 322 kcal (roasted with oil/herbs, adds some fat; use ~110 kcal/100 g → ~394 kcal)
- Grain: 77 g × 110 ≈ 85 kcal (bulgur/couscous cooked)
- Vegetables: 38 g × 40 ≈ 15 kcal (cooked with a little oil, ~50 → 19 kcal)
- Creamy salad: 144 g × 150 ≈ 216 kcal (mayo/cheese-style dressing)
- Garnish: 2 g × 30 ≈ 1 kcal

Adjusted total ≈ 394 + 85 + 19 + 216 + 1 ≈ 715 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A largely covered dinner plate with roasted potatoes and a creamy salad at roughly 600 g and about 700 kcal is plausible for a full plated meal.
